splash: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: polished landscape splash screen / cover artwork for a real local audiobook application called PageSpindle. Create an original distinctive vivid editorial paper-sculpture illustration and elegant brand composition, 16:9 landscape. Main subject: a beautiful open navy-blue book on a silver reading desk, its ivory pages flowing as a ribbon through a small golden spindle / reel and becoming turquoise sound waves that curl into a pair of rich coral headphones; a few small page tabs, a pencil, and a softly textured paper backdrop make this feel like a reader's creative workbench. Colors: deep navy, silver-white, saturated teal, golden yellow, coral and a little sky blue. Friendly and sophisticated, lively but uncluttered, crisp tactile shapes with subtle depth, no sci-fi glow, no purple gradients, no stock-photo laptop. Composition: large highly readable brand typography in the upper-left / left third, artwork in right half and lower area with ample breathing space; professional software splash rather than generic marketing landing page. Exact text, spelled perfectly: 'PageSpindle' and beneath it 'Spin text into listening'. A small tasteful line of text at lower left: 'Prepare · Review · Listen'. Include a row of five cohesive small colorful pictorial symbols near the bottom: document/folder (import), pencil-and-spark (prepare), side-by-side pages with check (review), microphone with wave (narrate), and audiobook with downward arrow (save). These are pictorial icons, no extra icon labels. No fake download buttons, no unsupported platform claims, no dates, no watermarks, no third-party logos. PageSpindle must be exactly one word with capital P and S. This is original app brand/splash concept artwork.
